action.description: Runtime-evidence operation: import (default) validates and summarizes one capture; correlate joins one capture to the leased graph; compare validates two capture identities before returning normalized deltas.

sourcePath.description: Generic JSON/CSV or structural Unity ProfilerRecorder receipt inside the analyzed workspace. Relative paths resolve from workspace root.

candidatePath.description: Second workspace-contained capture required by action:compare.

format.description: Optional source format hint. Auto-detected from content/path when omitted.

candidateFormat.description: Optional candidate format hint for action:compare.

comparisonMode.description: crossDevice (default) accepts reported device hardware differences while still gating scenario/build/platform/API/workload identity; strict requires identical device identity.

allowedDifferences.description: Explicit environmental fields accepted as different (width, height, refreshRateHz, or device fields in strict mode). Core scenario/build/workload gates cannot be bypassed.

markerAliases.description: Caller-owned marker mappings shaped as { marker, symbolId }. Exact aliases outrank capture hints, symbol names, and string-literal ownership; conflicting aliases remain Ambiguous.

maxMeasurements.description: Maximum imported measurement rows per capture. Default 10000; hard cap 100000. Complete observed count and truncation remain visible.

maxMarkers.description: Maximum correlation rows. Default 25 in summary mode or 200 in detail; hard cap 1000.

maxTestsPerSymbol.description: Maximum affected test classes projected per correlated symbol. Default 3 in summary mode or 10 in detail; hard cap 50.

maxDeltas.description: Maximum matched numeric delta rows. Default 50 in summary mode or 500 in detail; hard cap 5000.

summarize.description: Summary-first default true. Keeps identity/census complete while bounding marker, test, measurement-preview, and delta arrays.

snapshotId.description: Optional exact-publication selection. When present, the tool leases this retained current or graph-only historical snapshot instead of silently reading latest. Historical selections do not retain Roslyn services, so compilation-required tools return their normal unavailable-state result.

expectedSnapshotId.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this exact `snap_<32 lowercase hex>` identity; mismatch returns a structured retryable result without silently reading latest.

expectedAnalysisGeneration.description: Optional optimistic-read precondition. The tool runs only when the leased publication has this process-local generation; mismatch returns expected/actual identity and retry guidance.
